what: When a filter button is pressed, all cards vanish in .25s, then only the matching cards reappear one by one at .05s intervals over .35s

options.out: Length in seconds for everything to fade out, default .25 — 0 hides instantly with no fade and shows again
options.in: Duration (s) for the remaining cards to appear, default .35
options.each: Delay between cards when appearing (sec), default .05 — 0 means all at once
options.scroll: If given, tapping scrolls up to the filter panel header over that many seconds with power2.out (when ScrollToPlugin is loaded)
